title: Lightwell v0 product decisions
objective: Resolve and record product choices separately from engineering, prioritizing the minimal S0 image-loading skeleton and then the M1 non-destructive editor.
context_summary: Planning-only update, 2026-09-19. User now requires the first end-to-end build to be a cross-platform skeleton that loads an image with no editing tools. Previously agreed crop, export, persistence, live agents and Locate remain M1 follow-on requirements. TASK-001 preserves the ongoing interview; TASK-023 through TASK-034 track distinct choices and state when they are needed. Dependency-free ready decision tasks can be interviewed independently; future choices do not block S0. Implementation gates TASK-035 and TASK-064 check the specified answers and completion status via file links. No software has been implemented.

tasks.description: Set the minimal skeleton layout and loading/error behavior.
extra_context: Needed for S0 gate TASK-035; does not decide the future Library/Edit layout.
2026-09-19: concrete S0 defaults sent to owner during scaffold execution; awaiting response, not an accepted decision.

Owner accepted dark background, one Open image button, automatic Fit, brief loading/error messages and retention of previous photo after failed replacement. Input/profile contract still requires resolution; experimental exact-profile allowlist is not implicitly accepted.

Owner accepted standard sRGB/greyscale JPEG, automatic orientation correction and explicit unsupported-profile errors; broader color support later. Together with accepted shell behavior this completes the product decision, not implementation. Exact-profile probe allowlist is insufficient for general standard-sRGB support.
